Offences complained off: U/s. 498(A) R/w Sec.34 of  IPC & u/s 4 of D.P. Act.
Plea of accused : Pleaded not guilty Final Order : Accused are acquitted Date of Order : 01-06-2023  JUDGMENT Inspector of Police, Hebbal Police Station has filed charge sheet against accused for offences punishable under Section 498(A) R/w Sec.34 of IPC and under Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Brief facts of prosecution case are that:-
The marriage of C.W.1 was fixed with deceased Naresh and at that time accused No.1 to 4 had demanded gold ornaments as dowry.
Later accused persons refused to perform marriage of Naresh with C.W.1 due to non matching of their horoscope.
Thereafter despite refusal of accused No.1 to 4, C.W.1 married deceased Naresh at Arya Samaj on 12.07.2020 and thereafter Naresh expired.
For said reason accused No.1 to 4 came to house of C.W.1 and ill-treated her saying that she herself is responsible for death of said Naresh.
Thereafter on 22-12-2020 C.W.1 lodged first information before Hebbal PS.
Said police registered the case in their PS Cr.No.220/2020 and issued FIR.
After recording statements of material witnesses and after conclusion of investigation, I.O. has filed charge sheet against accused for above offences.
3. After filing of this charge sheet against accused No.1 to 4, cognizance of above offences is appeared in pursuant to summons and they are enlarged on bail.
Copy of charge sheet furnished to accused u/s 207 of Cr.P.C. Charge is framed against accused.
Said accused have not pleaded guilt of alleged offences and they have claimed to be tried.
4. In order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 to 4, prosecution has examined 1 witness as P.W.1 and got marked 3 documents as per Exs.P1 to P3.
However, statement of accused u/s 313 Cr.P.C. is dispensed with as there is no incriminating evidence against them.

sentences.text:
5. On the basis of charge sheet allegations, the following points arose for consideration:
1.
Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubts that marriage of C.W.1 was fixed with deceased Naresh and at that time accused No.1 to 4 had demanded gold ornaments as dowry.

Later accused persons refused to perform marriage of Naresh with C.W.1 due to non matching of horoscope and thereby accused No.1 to 4 have committed offense punishable under Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act?

2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubts that thereafter despite refusal of accused No.1 to 4, C.W.1 married deceased Naresh at Arya Samaj on 12.07.2020 and thereafter Naresh expired and for said reason accused No.1 to 4 came to house of C.W.1 and ill-treated her saying that she herself is responsible for death of said Naresh and thereby accused No.1 to 4 have committed offense punishable under Sec.498A r/w sec.34 of IPC ?
3. What order ?
6. Heard arguments.
Perused oral and documentary evidence adduced by the prosecution.
7. The following are findings to above points.
Point No.1 and 2: In the Negative Point No.3 : As per final order, for the following:

REASONS 8. Point No.1and 2:- These points are taken together for consideration as findings on one point have bearing on other points.
9.

In support of its case, prosecution has got examined C.W.1/first informant-cum-victim of the case by name Ramya W/o Naresh as P.W.1 and she has completely turned hostile by testifying that the accused persons have never ill-treated her and they have never demanded and received any dowry during her marriage.

Though P.W.1 has identified first information lodged by her as per Ex.P1, spot mahazar said to have been conducted by police as per Ex.P2 and her signatures on said documents as per Ex.P1(a) and Ex.P2(a), she has stated that she signed said documents as per request of police,
when she had been to police station due to some misunderstanding with accused.
She has further stated that she does not know the contents of said documents.

10. Though P.W.1 is treated as hostile witness and cross-examined at length by learned APP, nothing worth while is elicited from her mouth in order to prove that accused have ill-treated her and they demanded dowry as per case of prosecution.

P.W.1 has also denied to have given further statement before I.O. as per Ex.P3.
11.
Hence in view of hostile evidence of aforesaid principal witness, rest of prosecution witnesses are dropped as no purpose of prosecution will be served by examining them.

Hence absolutely there is State By Hebbal vs No.1 To 4 on 1 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155315851/
3 nothing on record to prove that accused No.1 to 4 have committed alleged offences.

sentences.text: Hence in view of above reasons, the evidence of prosecution witness has not inspired the confidence of the Court with regard to alleged guilt of accused and as such it is incumbent upon this Court to hold that the prosecution has failed to prove beyond all reasonable doubt that accused No.1 to 4 have committed offences punishable under Section 498(A) R/w Sec.34 of IPC and under Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Hence, Point No.1 and 2 are answered in Negative.
12. Point No.3: -

For the reasons stated and findings given on point No.1 and 2, following is:
ORDER
Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 to 4 are acquitted for the offences punishable under Section 498(A) R/w Sec.34 of IPC and under Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bond and surety bond executed by accused Nos.1 to 4 shall continue for a period of two months from the date of this order and thereafter same shall stand canceled automatically.
(Dictated to the Stenographer, typed by her directly on computer, revised, corrected by me and then pronounced in open court on this the 1st day of June 2023).
